provenance.title: Binary min-heap priority queue functions
provenance.hidden_tests: derived from upstream TestHeap: push/pop invariant, heapify, naive nbest, nbest via heapreplace and heappushpop, heappushpop edge cases, heapsort, nsmallest/nlargest with and without key (seeded RNG); plus tie-stability and heapreplace cases.
provenance.trimmed_detail: heapq.py: removed merge() and the `from _heapq import *` C-accelerator blocks / __main__ doctest; test_heapq.py kept verbatim (its merge/C tests are out of scope).
provenance.reference: hand-written idiomatic Jac port (claude), validated by convert_build
